The requirement says each link to a specialized file must say when to read it. The skill has one markdown link, `[CI example](../habeas/references/ci.md)`, in workflow step 9. The skill also mentions `references/authoring-failures.md`, `references/fixme.md` and `references/distributed-requirements.md`. These appear as inline code with a condition, not as markdown links. Each carries a trigger anyway:
- "If it fails, read ... `references/authoring-failures.md`".
- "if the user defers it".
- "propose a distributed requirement ... read ... `references/distributed-requirements.md`".

No violation matches were listed. I found no unconditioned link, so I found no gap.
